title: A Clinical Trial of a Vitamin/Nutriceutical Formulation for Alzheimer's Disease
brief_summary: Based on prior published pilot studies, the investigators have initiated a larger, multi-site placebo-controlled clinical trial with Alzheimer's disease (AD) patients and individuals diagnosed with Mild Cognitive Impairment (MCI), with the hopes of (1) confirming (or denying) the above promising clinical findings, and (2) determining whether or not our formulation can delay MCI "conversion" to AD.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinical diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease or Mild Cognitive Impairment
* must be able to swallow pills

Exclusion Criteria:

* known or suspected bipolar disorder
